watches.name: T04 - Violet
watches.description: Expected delivery : July 2026 The T04 Violet is defined by its flinqué grand feu enamel dial. A flinqué grand feu enamel dial constructed on a solid silver base. Multiple layers of enamel are kiln-fired at high temperature, creating optical depth through multiple enamel layers that cannot be printed or replicated. A dial built in fire Each dial begins with a solid silver base, precision-machined with a guilloché pattern. Layers of enamel are applied and fired repeatedly at approximately 780–820°C. With each firing, the material transforms — building depth and permanence. The result is not a surface, but a field of light. From guilloché to enamel The guilloché beneath the enamel is cut to control reflection. As light passes through the translucent enamel, the pattern shifts and re-emerges. This creates depth that cannot be achieved through printing or lacquer. Grand feu, done in-house All enamel work is executed in-house. Each dial undergoes multiple firings. A significant portion of dials do not pass final inspection. Material Dial base: pure silver Surface: guilloché Finish: grand feu enamel (multi-layer, kiln-fired) Process: in-house enamel firing, flinqué enamel Origin: Singapore Three color variants. Fifty pieces. Luxury in its rarest form . Specifications: Material: Case, case back and crown : SS 316L stainless steel Water Resistance: 5 ATM Dimensions: Diameter: 39mm; Lug to Lug: 46.5mm; Thickness: 8mm Dial: Flinqué grand feu enamel on pure silver Glass: Sapphire Crystal, front and back Movement: Swiss ETA 7001; Manual winding Strap: Swift leather with lining Zematt Calfskin Warranty: 2 years international Shipping: International free shipping

watches.name: T03 - Blue
watches.description: Discover the perfect fusion of tradition and innovation with the ETIEN T03 luxury wristwatch. Admire the intricate flinqué technique, guilloche and enamel dial, meticulously crafted using CNC engine-turned technology and layered with multiple coats of translucent cold enamel. The T03 watch dial goes beyond the ordinary, featuring revolving tracks radiating from the center, blending timeless guilloche patterns with vibrant enamel for a truly classic look. The sapphire crystal front and back sparkle in the light, revealing the watch’s intricate details and the precision of its Swiss ETA 7001 movement. Each piece is handmade with the renowned Flinqué Enamel technique, a nod to the legacy of Peter Carl Fabergé . Experience the elegance and craftsmanship of ETIEN’s luxury watch collections Experience the magic of ETIEN’s luxury watch collections for yourself.
